prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Centered Stage Redesign: Redesign the path selection screen with a centered stage layout presenting starter options clearly.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Select Your Pet Experience", "body": "Choose a pre-made companion or build your own custom desktop pet.", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Choose Experience", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Pet Spawn Guidance Screen: Add a new screen right before waiting completes showing visual instructions on where the pet appears on the taskbar.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "new_spawn_guide", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_spawn_guide": {"headline": "Locating Your Pet on Desktop", "body": "Your pet will spawn near your system tray once loading completes.", "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "image", "asset": "asset:desktop_spawn_preview", "style": "rounded"}]}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Photo Styling Customization Flow: Introduce a stage layout with photo picker and preview components during photo upload.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Customize Your Pet Appearance", "body": "Adjust photo framing and style filters for your custom pet.", "components": [{"type": "photo_picker", "label": "Upload Photo", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:custom_pet_render", "style": "rounded"}]}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Adoption Certificate: Reorder the onboarding sequence so sign-in happens after adoption certificate creation.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"], "sign_in": {"headline": "Save Your New Pet", "body": "Create or sign in to your account to save your newly adopted pet permanently."}}
4: [finish, layout] Desktop Controls Quick Reference Card: Switch home intro to a checklist layout displaying key pet interaction shortcuts.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Essential Desktop Pet Controls", "body": "Learn the basics to interact with your pet on screen.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Right-click pet for settings menu", "style": "calm"}, {"type": "checklist", "text": "Double-click pet to open chat window", "style": "calm"}]}}
5: [home, wait_info] Live Generation Progress Wait Info: Display dynamic progress bar and estimated time on the waiting screen during pet rendering.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "headline": "Preparing Your Pet Desktop Assets", "body": "We are assembling animations and interactions for your pet.", "components": [{"type": "progress", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "timer", "style": "subtle"}]}}
6: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Name Validation Hint: Add an explicit explanatory hint on the adoption certificate screen about name binding to accounts.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"hint": "Your pet name is locked to your account so you can restore it anytime.", "headline": "Official Adoption Certificate"}}
7: [finish, incentive] Completion Desktop Shortcut Incentive: Display a playful badge on the final home intro screen highlighting unlocked starter emotes.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Welcome Your Companion Home", "body": "Complete setup to unlock exclusive starter pet emotes!", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Starter Emotes Unlocked!", "style": "playful"}]}}
8: [sign_in, hint] Multi-Account Pet Recovery Hint: Add a hint on sign_in explaining that pets are bound to the specific sign-in account email.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Make sure to sign in with the same email you used previously to keep your pets.", "headline": "Sign In to Desktop Pets"}}
9: [choose_path, copy] Story Intro Pet Features Refresh: Update story screen text and button label to set clear expectations before path choice.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Welcome to Desktop Pets", "body": "Your new virtual companion lives right on your desktop window bar.", "button_label": "Get Started"}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns the path selection screen while retaining options for adopting pre-made or building custom pets.
Adding a new guidance screen inside onboarding before waiting completes is allowed.
Redesigns the photo upload flow while preserving its core function.
Reordering sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.
Home intro overlay layout changes inside onboarding are allowed.
Adding dynamic progress and time estimates during real pet rendering wait is allowed.
Adds account binding hint to the adoption certificate screen without losing its core purpose.
Onboarding copy mentions unlocked starter pet emote extras, violating Rule 3.
Adds account recovery hint on sign in screen without introducing prohibited patterns.
Updates story copy while continuing to introduce the desktop pet.
